msgid: I'm the DAY-CARE MAN.\pI help take care of the precious\nPOKéMON of TRAINERS.\pIf you'd like me to raise your\nPOKéMON, have a word with my wife.
msgstr: Je suis l’Hôte de la Pension.\pJe bichonne les Pokémon chéris\ndes Dresseurs.\pVa voir ma femme si tu veux\nme confier tes Pokémon.
preuve: SS 439:0 « Je suis l’Hôte de la Pension.\rNous bichonnons les Pokémon\nchéris des Dresseurs.\rVa voir ma femme si tu veux\nnous confier tes Pokémon. »
note: Hôte de la Pension (Ile 4, FRLG) au joueur : tutoiement comme SS/Émeraude. [non compilé]

msgid: Ah, it's you!\pWe were raising your POKéMON, and\nmy goodness, were we surprised!\pYour POKéMON had an EGG!\pWe don't know how it got there,\nbut your POKéMON had it.\pYou do want it, yes?
msgstr: Ah, c’est toi!\pNous nous occupions de ton Pokémon\net nous avons eu une énorme surprise!\pTon Pokémon a eu un Œuf!\pOn ne sait pas comment il est arrivé\nlà, mais ton Pokémon l’avait.\pTu le veux?
preuve: Émeraude FR : « Ah, c’est toi!\pNous nous occupions de ton POKéMON\net nous avons eu une énorme surprise!\pTon POKéMON a eu un OEUF!\pOn ne sait pas comment il est arrivé\nlà, mais ton POKéMON l’avait.\pTu le veux? »
note: Texte Émeraude identique (mise en page seule différente) ; OEUF → Œuf (glossaire). [non compilé]

msgid: We can raise two of your POKéMON.\pWould you like us to raise one\nmore POKéMON for you?
msgstr: Nous pouvons élever deux Pokémon.\pTu veux qu’on en élève un autre?
preuve: Émeraude FR : « Nous pouvons élever deux POKéMON.\nTu veux qu’on en élève un autre? »
note: Pension FRLG ; anglais légèrement différent (“one more POKéMON for you”), sens identique. [non compilé]

msgid: Ah, it's you!\nGood to see you.\pYour POKéMON can only be doing\ngood!
msgstr: Ah, c’est toi!\nContente de te voir.\pTon Pokémon est sûr d’être\nbien traité!
preuve: Émeraude FR : « Ah, c’est toi! Contente de te voir.\nTon POKéMON est sûr d’être bien traité! »
note: Dite par la femme de l’Hôte (comme dans Émeraude) ; mise en page FRLG. [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What does this person do?\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}OAK POKéMON RESEARCH LAB
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Que fait cette personne?\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Laboratoire Pokémon du Professeur\nChen
preuve: SS (panneau, déjà au .po) : « Laboratoire Pokémon du Professeur\nChen »
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). Rubriques : What does this person do? = Que fait cette personne? ; What is this person like? = Quel genre de personne est-ce? ; Family and friends? = Famille et amis? ; Favorite kind of POKéMON? = Pokémon préférés? ; There’s a rumor… = Une rumeur… ; Where was this person born? = Où est née cette personne? [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}To make a complete guide on all\nthe POKéMON in the world…\pThat was my dream!
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Quel genre de personne est-ce?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Créer un guide complet de tous\nles Pokémon du monde…\pC’était mon rêve!
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). Prof. Chen parle. [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}PROF. OAK may not look like much,\nbut he's the authority on POKéMON.\pMany POKéMON TRAINERS hold him in\nhigh regard.
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Quel genre de personne est-ce?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Le Prof. Chen ne paie pas de mine,\nmais c’est une sommité en matière de\lPokémon.\pBeaucoup de Dresseurs ont un grand\nrespect pour lui.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé).  [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Family and friends?\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}PROF. OAK reportedly lives with his\ngrandchildren, DAISY and {RIVAL}.
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Famille et amis?\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Le Prof. Chen vivrait avec ses\npetits-enfants, Nina et {RIVAL}.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). DAISY (sœur du rival) = Nina dans SoulSilver FR (banque 449). [non compilé]

msgid:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Family and friends?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}I hear OAK's taken a lot of
interest in you, child.\pThat old duff was once tough and
handsome.\pBut that was decades ago.
He's a shadow of his former self.
msgstr:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Famille et amis?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Il paraît que Chen s’intéresse
beaucoup à toi, mon petit.\pCe vieux bonhomme a été fort et beau
garçon, autrefois.\pMais c’était il y a des dizaines
d’années. Il n’est plus que l’ombre de\llui-même.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). Une vieille dame au joueur (tutoiement). [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What does this person do?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}PROF. OAK is going to have his own\nradio show soon.\pThe program will be called PROF.\nOAK'S POKéMON SEMINAR.
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Que fait cette personne?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Le Prof. Chen va bientôt avoir sa\npropre émission de radio.\pElle s’appellera “Le Séminaire\nPokémon du Prof. Chen”.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé).  [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What does this person do?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}If you show DAISY your POKéMON,\nshe can tell how much it likes you.\pOccasionally, she will even groom\na POKéMON for you.
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Que fait cette personne?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Si tu montres tes Pokémon à Nina, elle\npeut te dire à quel point ils t’aiment.\pIl lui arrive même de bichonner un\nPokémon.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). “groom” = bichonner (Nina, SoulSilver FR banque 449). [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}But the person who is most liked by\nPOKéMON is DAISY, I think.
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Quel genre de personne est-ce?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Mais la personne que les Pokémon\naiment le plus, c’est Nina, à mon avis.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé).  [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}She was gently grooming POKéMON…\nShe was a little angel.\pThat little girl's name…\nI think it was DAISY.
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Quel genre de personne est-ce?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Elle bichonnait tendrement des\nPokémon… On aurait dit un petit ange.\pCette petite fille s’appelait… Nina, je\ncrois.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé).  [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}A girl from PALLET TOWN, DAISY,\nshe enjoys TEA every day.\pShe visits the CELADON DEPT. STORE\nto buy some TEA.
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Quel genre de personne est-ce?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Une fille de Bourg Palette, Nina, boit\ndu thé tous les jours.\pElle va en acheter au Centre\nCommercial de Céladopole.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). TEA = Thé. [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}There's a rumor…\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}The Spring POKéMON CONTEST's\nGrand Champion is DAISY OAK of\lPALLET TOWN!
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Une rumeur…\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}La grande gagnante du Concours\nPokémon de printemps est Nina Chen,\lde Bourg Palette!
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé).  [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What does this person do?\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}PEWTER CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BROCK\lThe Rock-Solid POKéMON TRAINER!
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Que fait cette personne?\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Arène d’Argenta\nChampion: Pierre\lUn homme fort et dur comme la roche!
preuve: SS 460:21 « Arène d’Argenta\nChampion: Pierre\fUn homme fort et dur comme la roche! »
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). Panneau de l’Arène. [non compilé]

msgid:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Favorite kind of POKéMON?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}My rock-hard willpower is evident
in even my POKéMON.\pMy POKéMON are all rock hard and
have true-grit determination.\pThat's right - my POKéMON are all
the ROCK type!
msgstr:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Pokémon préférés?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Ma volonté de fer se voit jusque dans
mes Pokémon.\pMes Pokémon sont durs comme la pierre
et d’une détermination à toute\lépreuve.\pEh oui! Mes Pokémon sont tous de type
Roche!
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). Pierre parle. [non compilé]

msgid:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}There aren't many serious POKéMON
TRAINERS here.\pThey're all like BUG CATCHERS,
you know, just hobbyists.\pBut PEWTER GYM's BROCK isn't like
that, not one bit.
msgstr:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Quel genre de personne est-ce?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Il n’y a pas beaucoup de Dresseurs
sérieux, par ici.\pCe sont tous des genres de Scouts, tu
vois, des amateurs.\pMais Pierre, de l’Arène d’Argenta,
n’est pas du tout comme ça.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). BUG CATCHER = Scout. [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}BROCK is cool. He's not just tough.\nPeople like and respect him.\pI want to become a GYM LEADER\nlike him.
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Quel genre de personne est-ce?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Pierre est trop cool. Il n’est pas\njuste fort. Tout le monde l’aime et le\lrespecte.\pJe veux devenir un Champion d’Arène\ncomme lui.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé).  [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What does this person do?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Hi, I'm excavating for fossils here\nunder MT. MOON.\pSometimes, BROCK of PEWTER GYM\nlends me a hand.
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Que fait cette personne?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Salut, je fais des fouilles pour\ntrouver des fossiles ici, sous le Mont\lSélénite.\pDe temps en temps, Pierre, de l’Arène\nd’Argenta, me donne un coup de main.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé).  [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}BROCK rarely laughs, but is said to\nbe unable to stop if he starts.
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Quel genre de personne est-ce?\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Pierre rit rarement, mais quand il\ncommence, il ne peut plus s’arrêter.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). Même phrase que dans l’entrée Journal Pokémon (Pierre). [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What does this person do?\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}CERULEAN CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: MISTY\lThe Tomboyish Mermaid!
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Que fait cette personne?\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Arène d’Azuria\nChampion: Ondine\lNotre sirène favorite!
preuve: SS 467:14 « Arène d’Azuria\nChampion: Ondine\fNotre sirène favorite! »
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). Panneau de l’Arène. [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Favorite kind of POKéMON?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}My policy is an all-out offensive\nwith WATER-type POKéMON!
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Pokémon préférés?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Ma stratégie, c’est l’attaque à\noutrance avec des Pokémon Eau!
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). Ondine parle. [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}MISTY is a TRAINER who's going to\nkeep improving.\pShe won't lose to someone like you!
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Quel genre de personne est-ce?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Ondine est une Dresseuse qui va\ncontinuer à progresser.\pElle ne perdra pas contre quelqu’un\ncomme toi!
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé).  [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}There's a rumor…\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Strong TRAINERS and WATER POKéMON\nare common sights in these parts.\pThey say that MISTY of the\nCERULEAN GYM trains here.
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Une rumeur…\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Les Dresseurs forts et les Pokémon\nEau sont monnaie courante, par ici.\pOn dit qu’Ondine, de l’Arène d’Azuria,\ns’entraîne ici.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé).  [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}There's a rumor…\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}This cape is a famous date spot.\pMISTY, the GYM LEADER, has high\nhopes about this place.
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Une rumeur…\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Ce cap est un lieu de rendez-vous\ntrès connu.\pOndine, la Championne d’Arène, place\nde grands espoirs en cet endroit.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). Cap Azuria. [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}There's a rumor…\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}MISTY is said to worship LORELEI\nof the ELITE FOUR.
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Une rumeur…\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}On dit qu’Ondine voue un culte à Olga,\ndu Conseil 4.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). LORELEI = Olga (nom FR officiel Gen 1-4) ; même phrase que dans le Journal Pokémon (Ondine). [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What does this person do?\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}VERMILION CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: LT. SURGE\lThe Lightning American!
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Que fait cette personne?\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Arène de Carmin sur Mer\nChampion: Major Bob\lLe militaire survolté!
preuve: SS 483:11 « Arène de Carmin sur Mer\nChampion: Major Bob\fLe militaire survolté! »
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). Panneau de l’Arène. [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Favorite kind of POKéMON?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}I tell you, kid, electric POKéMON\nsaved me during the war!
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Pokémon préférés?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Je te le dis, petit, les Pokémon\nélectriques m’ont sauvé la vie\lpendant la guerre!
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). Major Bob parle. [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}When I was in the Army, LT. SURGE\nwas my strict CO.\pHe was a hard taskmaster.
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Quel genre de personne est-ce?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Quand j’étais à l’armée, le Major Bob\nétait mon supérieur, très strict.\pIl ne nous faisait pas de cadeaux.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé).  [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}LT. SURGE was always famous for\nhis cautious nature in the Army.
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Quel genre de personne est-ce?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}À l’armée, le Major Bob était connu\npour sa prudence.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé).  [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}LT. SURGE installed the traps in\nthe GYM himself.\pHe set up double locks everywhere.
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Quel genre de personne est-ce?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Le Major Bob a installé lui-même les\npièges de l’Arène.\pIl a mis des doubles verrous partout.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé).  [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}There's a rumor…\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}LT. SURGE is rumored to have been\na pilot while home in America.\pHe used the electricity generated\nby POKéMON to power his plane.
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Une rumeur…\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}On raconte que le Major Bob était\npilote quand il vivait en Amérique.\pIl faisait voler son avion grâce à\nl’électricité produite par des\lPokémon.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). Même texte que dans le Journal Pokémon (Major Bob). [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What does this person do?\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}CELADON CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: ERIKA\lThe Nature-Loving Princess!
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Que fait cette personne?\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Arène de Céladopole\nChampion: Erika\lLa Reine des Plantes
preuve: SS 491:31 « Arène de Céladopole\rChampion: Erika\nLa Reine des Plantes »
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). Panneau de l’Arène. [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Favorite kind of POKéMON?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}I am a student of the art of\nflower arranging.\pMy POKéMON are solely of the\nGRASS type.
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Pokémon préférés?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}J’étudie l’art de l’arrangement floral.\pMes Pokémon sont tous de type\nPlante.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). Erika parle. [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Our LEADER ERIKA might be quiet,\nbut she's famous around here.
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Quel genre de personne est-ce?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Notre Championne, Erika, est\npeut-être discrète, mais elle est\lcélèbre par ici.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé).  [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}We only use GRASS-type POKéMON at\nour GYM.\pWhy? We also use them for making\nflower arrangements!
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Quel genre de personne est-ce?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Dans notre Arène, on n’utilise que des\nPokémon de type Plante.\pPourquoi? Parce qu’on s’en sert aussi\npour faire des bouquets!
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé).  [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Favorite kind of POKéMON?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}I would never collect POKéMON if\nthey were unattractive.
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Pokémon préférés?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Jamais je ne collectionnerais des\nPokémon qui ne sont pas jolis.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé).  [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}There's a rumor…\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Rumor has it that if you peek into\nCELADON GYM, you can often\lsee ERIKA snoozing.
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Une rumeur…\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Il paraît que si on jette un œil dans\nl’Arène de Céladopole, on voit souvent\lErika faire la sieste.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé).  [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What does this person do?\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}FUCHSIA CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: KOGA\lThe Poisonous Ninja Master
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Que fait cette personne?\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Arène de Parmanie\nChampion: Koga\lLe maître ninja des poisons
preuve: Format SS 512:4 (« Arène de Parmanie\rChampion: Jeannine… ») ; slogan repris du panneau FuchsiaCity_Frlg du .po
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). Panneau de l’Arène (Koga, FRLG). [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Favorite kind of POKéMON?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Despair to the creeping horror of\nPOISON-type POKéMON!
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Pokémon préférés?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Désespère face à l’horreur rampante\ndes Pokémon de type Poison!
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). Koga parle. [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Even though I've lost, I will keep\ntraining according to the teachings\lof KOGA, my ninja master.
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Quel genre de personne est-ce?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Même si j’ai perdu, je continuerai à\nm’entraîner selon les enseignements\lde Koga, mon maître ninja.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé).  [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Family and friends?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}My father is the GYM LEADER of\nthis town.\pI'm training to use POISON POKéMON\nas well as my father.
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Famille et amis?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Mon père est le Champion d’Arène de\ncette ville.\pJe m’entraîne à utiliser les Pokémon\nPoison aussi bien que lui.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). La fille de Koga parle. [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}There's a rumor…\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}KOGA is said to have a thorough\nknowledge of medicine.\pHe even concocts medicine to nurse\nhis POKéMON to health.
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Une rumeur…\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}On dit que Koga a une connaissance\napprofondie de la médecine.\pIl prépare même des remèdes pour\nsoigner ses Pokémon.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). Même texte que dans le Journal Pokémon (Koga). [non compilé]

msgid:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What does this person do?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}The SAFARI ZONE's huge, wouldn't
you say?\pFUCHSIA's GYM LEADER, KOGA, 
patrols the grounds every so often.\pThanks to him, we can play here
knowing that we're safe.
msgstr:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Que fait cette personne?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Il est immense, ce Parc Safari, tu ne
trouves pas?\pKoga, le Champion d’Arène de Parmanie,
patrouille dans le parc de temps en\ltemps.\pGrâce à lui, on peut s’amuser ici en
toute sécurité.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé).  [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What does this person do?\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}SAFFRON CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: SABRINA\lThe Master of PSYCHIC POKéMON!
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Que fait cette personne?\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Arène de Safrania\nChampion: Morgane\lLa maîtresse des Pokémon Psy!
preuve: SS 529:12 « Arène de Safrania\rChampion: Morgane\nLa maîtresse des Pokémon Psy! »
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). Panneau de l’Arène. [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Favorite kind of POKéMON?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}You know about a girl GYM LEADER\nin SAFFRON CITY?\pShe uses PSYCHIC-type POKéMON,\nright?
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Pokémon préférés?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Tu connais la Championne d’Arène de\nSafrania?\pElle utilise des Pokémon de type Psy,\nnon?
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé).  [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}I have had psychic powers since\nI was a child.\pIt started when a spoon I\ncarelessly tossed, bent.
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Quel genre de personne est-ce?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}J’ai des pouvoirs psychiques depuis\nque je suis toute petite.\pTout a commencé quand une cuillère\nque j’avais lancée sans y penser s’est\ltordue.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). Morgane parle. [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}I dislike battling, but if you wish,\nI will show you my powers!
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Quel genre de personne est-ce?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Je n’aime pas combattre, mais si tu y\ntiens, je vais te montrer mes\lpouvoirs!
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). Morgane au joueur. [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}There's a rumor…\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}People say that SABRINA can\ncommunicate with her POKéMON\lduring battle without speaking.
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Une rumeur…\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}On dit que Morgane peut communiquer\navec ses Pokémon pendant un combat\lsans dire un mot.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). Même texte que dans le Journal Pokémon (Morgane). [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}SABRINA just wiped out the KARATE\nMASTER next door.
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Quel genre de personne est-ce?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Morgane vient de pulvériser le Maître\nKaraté d’à côté.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). KARATE MASTER = Maître Karaté (dojo de Safrania). [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What does this person do?\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}CINNABAR ISLAND POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BLAINE\lThe Hotheaded Quiz Master!
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Que fait cette personne?\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Arène de Cramois’Ile\nChampion: Auguste\lLe roi du quiz au sang chaud!
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). Panneau de l’Arène ; BLAINE = Auguste (SS). [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Favorite kind of POKéMON?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}My fiery POKéMON are all rough\nand ready with intense heat!\pThey incinerate all challengers!
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Pokémon préférés?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Mes Pokémon de feu sont tous prêts à\nen découdre, brûlants d’ardeur!\pIls réduisent tous les adversaires en\ncendres!
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). Auguste parle. [non compilé]

msgid:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Favorite kind of POKéMON?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Our LEADER, BLAINE, became lost
in the mountains but good.\pNight fell when a fiery bird
POKéMON appeared.\pIts light allowed BLAINE to find
his way down safely.
msgstr:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Pokémon préférés?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Notre Champion, Auguste, s’était
complètement perdu dans les\lmontagnes.\pLa nuit tombait quand un oiseau
Pokémon de feu est apparu.\pSa lumière a permis à Auguste de
redescendre sain et sauf.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé).  [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}CINNABAR GYM's BLAINE is quite the\nodd fellow.\pHe's lived on the island since way\nbefore the LAB was built.
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Quel genre de personne est-ce?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Auguste, de l’Arène de Cramois’Ile,\nest un drôle de bonhomme.\pIl vit sur l’île depuis bien avant la\nconstruction du Laboratoire.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé).  [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Family and friends?\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}It's a photo of BLAINE and\nMR. FUJI.\pThey're standing shoulder to\nshoulder with big grins.
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Famille et amis?\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}C’est une photo d’Auguste et de\nM. Fuji.\pIls se tiennent épaule contre épaule\navec un grand sourire.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). MR. FUJI = M. Fuji (SS). [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}There's a rumor…\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}BLAINE is said to remove his dark\nshades only when he is thinking up\lnew quiz questions.
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Une rumeur…\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}On dit qu’Auguste n’enlève ses\nlunettes noires que pour inventer de\lnouvelles questions de quiz.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). Même texte que dans le Journal Pokémon (Auguste). [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What does this person do?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}I am LORELEI of the ELITE FOUR.
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Que fait cette personne?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Je suis Olga, du Conseil 4.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). Olga parle. [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Favorite kind of POKéMON?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}No one can best me when it comes\nto icy POKéMON.
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Pokémon préférés?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Personne ne peut me battre quand il\ns’agit de Pokémon de glace.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé).  [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Where was this person born?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}We've had a great and powerful\nTRAINER grow up on this island.\pI bet even you'd know her.\nIt's LORELEI of the ELITE FOUR!
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Où est née cette personne?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Une grande et puissante Dresseuse a\ngrandi sur cette île.\pMême toi, tu dois la connaître. C’est\nOlga, du Conseil 4!
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé).  [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Known for her logical, calculated,\nand cool battling style, LORELEI\lhas a surprising secret!
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Quel genre de personne est-ce?\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Connue pour son style de combat\nlogique, calculé et froid, Olga cache\lun secret surprenant!
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). Même texte que dans le Journal Pokémon (Olga). [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Did you know that LORELEI has lots\nand lots of stuffed dolls?\pEvery time she comes back to\nFOUR ISLAND, her collection grows!
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Quel genre de personne est-ce?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Tu savais qu’Olga a des tas et des tas\nde peluches?\pChaque fois qu’elle revient à l’Ile 4,\nsa collection s’agrandit!
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). FOUR ISLAND = Ile 4 (forme du .po, à confirmer). [non compilé]

msgid:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Favorite kind of POKéMON?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}The LAPRAS she has, I imagine it
to be the one she met as a child.\pI believe it was in ICEFALL CAVE
that she caught it.\pPerhaps that POKéMON has been with
her ever since.
msgstr:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Pokémon préférés?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Le LOKHLASS qu’elle a, j’imagine que
c’est celui qu’elle a rencontré quand\lelle était petite.\pJe crois que c’est dans la Grotte de
Glace qu’elle l’a attrapé.\pCe Pokémon est peut-être resté avec
elle depuis.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). ICEFALL CAVE = Grotte de Glace (nom FRLG FR non vérifié). [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What does this person do?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}I am BRUNO of the ELITE FOUR!
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Que fait cette personne?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Je suis Aldo, du Conseil 4!
preuve: SS 525:0 « Je suis Aldo du Conseil 4. »
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). Aldo parle. [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Favorite kind of POKéMON?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}I've lived and trained with my\nfighting POKéMON!
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Pokémon préférés?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}J’ai vécu et je me suis entraîné avec\nmes Pokémon Combat!
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé).  [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}BRUNO apparently joined the ELITE\nFOUR out of his burning ambition to\lbattle the best TRAINERS.
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Quel genre de personne est-ce?\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Aldo serait entré au Conseil 4 par\nambition, pour affronter les meilleurs\lDresseurs.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). Même texte que dans le Journal Pokémon (Aldo). [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}BRUNO, who's a senior ahead of me,\nvisits the SPA on occasion.\pHe comes to rehab injuries, both\nhis own and his POKéMON's.
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Quel genre de personne est-ce?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Aldo, qui est mon aîné, vient parfois\naux thermes.\pIl vient soigner ses blessures et\ncelles de ses Pokémon.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). SPA (Ile 1) = thermes. [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}There's a rumor…\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}He's one of the ELITE FOUR.\nHis name is BRUNO.\pHe went away disappointed when he\nfound out that they were all sold\lout of Rage Candybars.
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Une rumeur…\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Il fait partie du Conseil 4. Il\ns’appelle Aldo.\pIl est reparti tout déçu quand il a\nappris qu’il n’y avait plus de Bonbons\lRage.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). Rage Candybar = Bonbon Rage (glossaire). [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Family and friends?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Even BRUNO…\nHe trained with a fellow by the\lname of BRAWLY before.
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Famille et amis?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Même Aldo… Il s’est déjà entraîné\navec un certain BASTIEN.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). BRAWLY = BASTIEN (Émeraude FR). [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What does this person do?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}I am AGATHA of the ELITE FOUR.
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Que fait cette personne?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Je suis Agatha, du Conseil 4.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). Agatha parle. [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Favorite kind of POKéMON?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}AGATHA's GHOST-type POKéMON are\nhorrifically terrifying in toughness.
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Pokémon préférés?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Les Pokémon Spectre d’Agatha sont\nd’une force effroyable.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé).  [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}That old lady's also got a really\nshort fuse, too.\pIt doesn't take anything to get\nthat scary lady hollering.
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Quel genre de personne est-ce?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Cette vieille dame a aussi un sale\ncaractère.\pIl ne faut pas grand-chose pour\nqu’elle se mette à hurler.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé).  [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}There's a rumor…\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}In her youth, AGATHA and PROF.\nOAK were rivals who vied for\lsupremacy as TRAINERS.
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Une rumeur…\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Dans leur jeunesse, Agatha et le\nProf. Chen étaient rivaux et se\ldisputaient le titre de meilleur\lDresseur.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). Même texte que dans le Journal Pokémon (Agatha). [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Take AGATHA, for example.\pShe set a record for being the\noldest-ever ELITE FOUR member.
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Quel genre de personne est-ce?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Prends Agatha, par exemple.\pElle détient le record du membre le\nplus âgé de l’histoire du Conseil 4.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé).  [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What does this person do?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}I lead the ELITE FOUR.\pYou can call me LANCE the dragon\nTRAINER.
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Que fait cette personne?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Je suis à la tête du Conseil 4.\pAppelle-moi Peter, le Dresseur de\ndragons.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). Peter parle. [non compilé]

msgid:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Favorite kind of POKéMON?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}You know that dragons are
mythical POKéMON.\pThey're hard to catch and raise,
but their powers are superior.\pThey're virtually indestructible.
There's no being clever with them.
msgstr:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Pokémon préférés?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Tu sais que les dragons sont des
Pokémon légendaires.\pIls sont difficiles à attraper et à
élever, mais leur puissance est\lsupérieure.\pIls sont pratiquement
indestructibles. Pas moyen de ruser\lavec eux.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). “mythical” rendu par “légendaires”. [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}He stands for justice!\nHe's cool, and yet passionate!\lHe's the greatest, LANCE!
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Quel genre de personne est-ce?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Il défend la justice! Il est cool, et\npourtant si passionné! C’est le\lmeilleur, Peter!
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé).  [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}There's a rumor…\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}We have a customer, LANCE, who\noccasionally comes.\pHe always buys capes.\pI wonder… Does he have many\nidentical capes at home?
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Une rumeur…\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Nous avons un client, Peter, qui passe\nde temps en temps.\pIl achète toujours des capes.\pJe me demande… A-t-il plein de capes\nidentiques chez lui?
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). Vendeuse du Centre Commercial. [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Family and friends?\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}LANCE's grandfather is thought to\nbe the elder of a famous clan of\ldragon masters.
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Famille et amis?\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Le grand-père de Peter serait\nl’ancien d’un célèbre clan de maîtres\ldragons.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). Même texte que dans le Journal Pokémon (Peter). [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Family and friends?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}From what I've heard, LANCE has\na cousin who's a GYM LEADER\lsomewhere far away.
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Famille et amis?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}D’après ce que j’ai entendu, Peter a\nune cousine qui est Championne\ld’Arène quelque part très loin.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). Allusion à Sandra ; “cousin” rendu au féminin. [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What does this person do?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}After all, BILL's world-famous as a\nPOKéMANIAC.\pHe invented the POKéMON Storage\nSystem on PC, too.
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Que fait cette personne?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Après tout, Léo est un Pokémaniac\nmondialement connu.\pC’est aussi lui qui a inventé le\nSystème de Stockage Pokémon sur PC.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). BILL = Léo (SS). [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Favorite kind of POKéMON?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}BILL has lots of POKéMON!\nHe collects rare ones, too!
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Pokémon préférés?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Léo a des tas de Pokémon! Il en\ncollectionne aussi des rares!
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé).  [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}He's my grandson!\pHe always liked collecting things,\neven as a child!
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Quel genre de personne est-ce?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}C’est mon petit-fils!\pIl a toujours aimé collectionner des\nchoses, même tout petit!
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). Le grand-père de Léo parle. [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Favorite kind of POKéMON?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}BILL is a POKéMANIAC, so he loves\nevery kind.\pApparently, the first one he caught\nwas an ABRA.
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Pokémon préférés?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Léo est un Pokémaniac, alors il les\naime tous.\pIl paraît que le premier qu’il a\nattrapé était un ABRA.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé).  [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Family and friends?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}BILL's hometown is GOLDENROD CITY,\nwhere his folks still live.\pI've heard that it's quite the\nfestive, bustling city.
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Famille et amis?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Léo est originaire de Doublonville, où\nvit encore sa famille.\pIl paraît que c’est une ville très\nanimée et festive.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé).  [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}There's a rumor…\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Apparently, BILL simply can't\nstomach milk at all.
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Une rumeur…\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Il paraît que Léo ne supporte pas du\ntout le lait.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé).  [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What does this person do?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}He's really kind.\pHe looks after abandoned and\norphaned POKéMON.
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Que fait cette personne?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Il est vraiment gentil.\pIl s’occupe des Pokémon abandonnés\net orphelins.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). À propos de M. Fuji. [non compilé]

msgid:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}This old guy marched right up to
our HIDEOUT.\pThen, he starts ranting about how
TEAM ROCKET's abusing POKéMON.\pSo, we're just talking it over as
adults.
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Quel genre de personne est-ce?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Ce vieux bonhomme a débarqué dans\nnotre repaire.\pEt le voilà qui se met à râler parce\nque la Team Rocket maltraite les\lPokémon.\pAlors on en discute entre adultes.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). Un Sbire Rocket parle de M. Fuji. [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}POKéMON FAN MAGAZINE\nMonthly Grand Prize Drawing!\pThe application form is…\pGone! It's been clipped out.\nSomeone must have applied already.
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Quel genre de personne est-ce?\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Magazine des fans de Pokémon\nGrand tirage au sort mensuel!\pLe bulletin de participation est…\pParti! Il a été découpé. Quelqu’un a\ndéjà dû participer.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé).  [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}There's a rumor…\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}I hear that MR. FUJI's not from\nthese parts originally, either.
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Une rumeur…\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Il paraît que M. Fuji n’est pas non\nplus d’ici, à l’origine.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé).  [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Editor: The shy MR. FUJI turned\ndown our interview requests.\pHe is a kindly man who is adored\nand respected in LAVENDER TOWN.
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Quel genre de personne est-ce?\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Note de la rédaction: le timide M. Fuji\na décliné nos demandes d’interview.\pC’est un homme bienveillant, adoré et\nrespecté à Lavanville.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). Même texte que dans le Journal Pokémon (M. Fuji). [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What does this person do?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}TEAM ROCKET captures POKéMON from\naround the world.\pThey're important tools for keeping\nour criminal enterprise going.\pI am the leader, GIOVANNI!
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Que fait cette personne?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}La Team Rocket capture des Pokémon\ndans le monde entier.\pCe sont des outils essentiels au bon\nfonctionnement de notre\lorganisation criminelle.\pJe suis le chef, Giovanni!
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). Giovanni parle. [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Favorite kind of POKéMON?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Those thugs that took over our\nbuilding…\pTheir BOSS said he was looking for\nstrong POKéMON.
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Pokémon préférés?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Ces voyous qui ont pris notre\nimmeuble…\pLeur Boss a dit qu’il cherchait des\nPokémon puissants.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). Employé de Sylphe SARL. [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}TEAM ROCKET's BOSS is terribly\ncruel!\pTo him, POKéMON are just tools to\nbe used.
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Quel genre de personne est-ce?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Le Boss de la Team Rocket est d’une\ncruauté terrible!\pPour lui, les Pokémon ne sont que des\noutils.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé).  [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What does this person do?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Welcome to my hideout!\pIt shall be so until I can restore\nTEAM ROCKET to its former glory.
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Que fait cette personne?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Bienvenue dans mon repaire!\pIl le restera jusqu’à ce que la Team\nRocket retrouve sa gloire passée.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). Giovanni parle. [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What does this person do?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Blow me away! GIOVANNI was the\nGYM LEADER of VIRIDIAN?
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Que fait cette personne?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Ça alors! Giovanni était le Champion\nde l’Arène de Jadielle?
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé).  [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Family and friends?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}You… You're not GIOVANNI's kid,\nare you?\pNo, that can't be right.\nGIOVANNI's kid has red hair.
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Famille et amis?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Tu… Tu ne serais pas l’enfant de\nGiovanni?\pNon, impossible. L’enfant de Giovanni\na les cheveux roux.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé).  [non compilé]

msgid:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: PROF. OAK
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Why do POKéMON compete and battle
so hard for you?\pThey do so because they can see
the love and trust you have\ltowards POKéMON.\pNever forget that.
msgstr:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}De: Prof. Chen
À: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Pourquoi les Pokémon se donnent-ils
autant de mal au combat pour toi?\pParce qu’ils voient l’amour et la
confiance que tu leur portes.\pNe l’oublie jamais.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). Messages finaux : “From: X / To: {PLAYER}” = “De: X / À: {PLAYER}”. [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}DAISY
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Nina
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). Nom de Daisy Chen dans SoulSilver FR. [non compilé]

msgid:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: DAISY
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}While I was comfortably enjoying
my tea breaks, you've grown very\lskilled and powerful.\pI hope you'll remain a good rival
to my little brother.
msgstr:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}De: Nina
À: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Pendant que je prenais
tranquillement mon thé, tu es devenu\ltrès fort et très doué.\pJ’espère que tu resteras un bon rival
pour mon petit frère.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). Accord masculin “devenu” (le texte ne varie pas selon le sexe du joueur). [non compilé]

msgid:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: BROCK
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}In this big world of ours, there
must be many tough TRAINERS.\pLet's both keep training and
making ourselves stronger!
msgstr:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}De: Pierre
À: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Dans ce vaste monde, il doit y avoir
beaucoup de Dresseurs forts.\pContinuons tous les deux à nous
entraîner pour devenir plus forts!
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé).  [non compilé]

msgid:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: MISTY
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}I'm going to keep training here at
this GYM.\pWhen I get better, I'd love to hit
the road and travel.
msgstr:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}De: Ondine
À: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Je vais continuer à m’entraîner ici,
dans mon Arène.\pQuand je serai meilleure, j’aimerais
bien prendre la route et voyager.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé).  [non compilé]

msgid:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: LT. SURGE
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Hey, kid!
You electrified me in our battle!\pI didn't know that there were
gutsy TRAINERS like you.\pIt made me change my mind about
you!
msgstr:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}De: Major Bob
À: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Hé, petit! Tu m’as électrisé pendant
notre combat!\pJe ne savais pas qu’il existait des
Dresseurs aussi courageux que toi.\pÇa m’a fait changer d’avis sur toi!
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé).  [non compilé]

msgid:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: ERIKA
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}I am so glad that there are strong
TRAINERS like you.\pThat awareness alone inspires and
motivates me to try harder.\pPlease visit me again.
Zzz…
msgstr:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}De: Erika
À: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Je suis si heureuse qu’il existe des
Dresseurs forts comme toi.\pRien que de le savoir, cela m’inspire
et me motive à faire encore mieux.\pReviens me voir, je t’en prie. Zzz…
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé).  [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}KOGA
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Koga
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). Nom en casse SoulSilver (l’entrée “KOGA” seule du .po est en capitales : à harmoniser). [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: KOGA\nTo: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}You and I, we must both set our\nsights higher and work towards\lmeeting our challenges.\pNow, I must go train my daughter.
msgstr:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}De: Koga
À: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Toi et moi, nous devons viser plus
haut et travailler pour relever nos\ldéfis.\pÀ présent, je dois aller entraîner ma
fille.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé).  [non compilé]

msgid:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: SABRINA
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}The love you have towards your
POKéMON…\pIt was a power that was never
bested by my psychic power.
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}De: Morgane\nÀ: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}L’amour que tu portes à tes Pokémon…\pC’est une force que mes pouvoirs\npsychiques n’ont jamais pu vaincre.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé).  [non compilé]

msgid:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: BLAINE
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}My fire POKéMON!
They'll become even more powerful!\pAnd now, a quiz. How many kinds of
FIRE-type POKéMON are there?
msgstr:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}De: Auguste
À: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Mes Pokémon de feu! Ils vont devenir
encore plus puissants!\pEt maintenant, un quiz! Combien
existe-t-il d’espèces de Pokémon de\ltype Feu?
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé).  [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}LORELEI
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Olga
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). LORELEI = Olga. [non compilé]

msgid:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: LORELEI
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}I needed to thank you for your
help.\pBut that has nothing to do with our
battles.\pYou'd better watch out next time!
msgstr:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}De: Olga
À: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Je tenais à te remercier pour ton
aide.\pMais ça n’a rien à voir avec nos
combats.\pLa prochaine fois, prends garde à toi!
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé).  [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}BRUNO
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Aldo
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé).  [non compilé]

msgid:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: BRUNO
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}The super power of your POKéMON
and you I've experienced myself.\pNext time, maybe I should show you
how to train yourself.
msgstr:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}De: Aldo
À: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}La puissance de tes Pokémon et la
tienne, je l’ai ressentie moi-même.\pLa prochaine fois, je devrais
peut-être t’apprendre à t’entraîner.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé).  [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}AGATHA
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Agatha
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé).  [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: AGATHA\nTo: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}When you grow older, don't you\ndare go soft like that coot OAK!\pBe like me and keep battling on!
msgstr:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}De: Agatha
À: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}En vieillissant, ne t’avise pas de
devenir mou comme ce vieux schnock\lde Chen!\pFais comme moi et continue de te
battre!
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé).  [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}LANCE
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Peter
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). Casse SoulSilver (l’entrée “LANCE” seule du .po donne “PETER” : à harmoniser). [non compilé]

msgid:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: LANCE
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}I'm considering going back to my
hometown.\pI want to retrain my DRAGON-type
POKéMON and strengthen them.\pI'd like to invite you to my
hometown one day.
msgstr:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}De: Peter
À: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}J’envisage de retourner dans ma ville
natale.\pJe veux reprendre l’entraînement de
mes Pokémon de type Dragon et les\lrenforcer.\pJ’aimerais t’inviter dans ma ville
natale, un jour.
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé).  [non compilé]

msgid:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: BILL
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Hey, there! CELIO had nothing but
praise for you.\pHearing that makes me happy.\pWhen you catch some rare POKéMON,
come show me, okay? Promise!
msgstr:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}De: Léo
À: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Salut! Celio ne tarit pas d’éloges sur
toi.\pÇa me fait plaisir d’entendre ça.\pQuand tu attraperas des Pokémon
rares, viens me les montrer, d’accord?\lPromis!
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). CELIO conservé (nom FRLG FR non vérifié). [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}MR. FUJI
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}M. Fuji
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé). MR. FUJI = M. Fuji (SS). [non compilé]

msgid:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: MR. FUJI
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Instead of hoping for the happiness
of just your POKéMON…\p…Can I get you to wish for the
happiness of all POKéMON?
msgstr:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}De: M. Fuji
À: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Au lieu d’espérer seulement le
bonheur de tes Pokémon…\p…Pourrais-tu souhaiter le bonheur de
tous les Pokémon?
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé).  [non compilé]

msgid: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}GIOVANNI
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Giovanni
note: Mémorydex (Fame Checker FRLG, non compilé).  [non compilé]

msgid:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: GIOVANNI
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}There is nothing that I wish to say
to you.\pI will concentrate solely on
bettering myself, and none other.
msgstr: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}De: Giovanni\nÀ: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Je n’ai rien à te dire.\pJe me concentrerai uniquement sur\nmon propre perfectionnement, rien\ld’autre.
